description: Cake 是一個相對具體的食品名詞，所以真正可用的近義／改寫並不多。 本課集中處理 broad dessert description, casual sweet-treat wording, rich gateau, sponge-cake subtype, celebration function, 和 formal bakery classification。

words.example: The café serves a different baked dessert each afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 這間咖啡店每天下午供應不同的烘焙甜點。

exercises.original: The restaurant serves cake as one of its evening desserts.
exercises.zh: 餐廳晚市甜品之一是蛋糕。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant serves a baked dessert as one of its evening options.

options.explanation: Baked dessert ✓ — a sweet dish made by baking, often served as dessert。本句關鍵是 the item is being classified broadly as a dessert；因此 Baked dessert 最精準。
Sweet baked treat — a sweet baked food eaten as a treat。sweet baked treat 是日常廣義說法；若句子明確是餐後 dessert category、精緻 gateau 或特定 cake subtype，會太一般。
Gateau — a rich or elaborate cake, often layered and decorated。gateau 只適合較精緻、濃厚、分層或奶油裝飾的蛋糕；一般 cake 不一定是 gateau。
Dessert — a sweet course served after a meal。dessert 是餐後甜品大類，cake 只是其中一種；它太廣。
Pastry — a baked food made from pastry dough。pastry 通常以 pastry dough 為基礎，與 cake 的結構／配方不同。
Bread — a staple baked food made from dough。bread 是另一類烘焙食品，通常不屬甜蛋糕。

falseSynonyms.zh: 甜品 ≠ cake dessert 是餐後甜品的大類；cake 只是其中一種。
酥皮／糕點 ≠ cake pastry 通常指以 pastry dough 製作的食品，與 cake 結構不同。
麵包 ≠ cake bread 通常不是甜蛋糕，配方與用途也不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Bread is a different baked-food category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餅乾／英式小餅 ≠ cake biscuit 是另一類烘焙食品，質地和份量不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Biscuit is a separate category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在精緻濃厚蛋糕 sense 接近 gateau 是 cake 的較窄子類。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Gateau is a subtype.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在海綿蛋糕 sense 接近 sponge cake 是特定蛋糕種類。
